fusions.name: Hobnail Stamp
fusions.desc: Stamps a studded heel into the ground, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking each back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Miles in the Kick
fusions.desc: A kick from a spiked sole deals 28 damage, ignores armour and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max +50%).

fusions.name: Strewn Caltrops
fusions.desc: Scatters caltrops in a line 4 tiles long in front of you for 8 seconds. The line deals 5 damage to any enemy that crosses it and slows it by 30% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Kicked-Up Points
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover, a spike kicked up from your heel flies at the nearest enemy within 5 tiles and deals 6 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
